text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I stopped by to observe dance 
practice, Sirius Symboli suddenly roped me 
into pair dance training!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hah, look who's slightly improved. Though 
your footwork on the turns is still 
newborn fawn level.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Harsh words, but since I knew she wasn't 
wrong, I couldn't talk back. Or maybe 
giving any credit at all was her version 
of kindness? —Just then:

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —Might I borrow a bit of your space?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I wished to dance with you. Would you 
grant me a song?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...What's your angle, coming out of your 
way like this?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There is no hidden motive. I simply felt 
the desire to dance.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hah! ...So that's how it is. Looks like 
our "Emperor" has plenty of free time on 
her hands, huh?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Hey, you!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Choose me. I'll take the lead.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Come, let us begin. This hand exists now 
only to take yours.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Um... Ah! Let's go with this song! It 
allows one person to take turns dancing 
with two partners! —I'm starting the 
music!

The music begins. Both of them lead with 
masterful skill. So much so that the 
students watching from the sidelines let 
out squeals of delight.

Sirius Symboli leads somewhat forcefully, 
yet she never leaves me behind for a 
single moment.

She sweeps me up into her own pace— a 
fiery dance that burns with intense 
passion.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You're dancing with me. Don't look away. 
—Keep your eyes on me.

Meanwhile, Symboli Rudolf adds momentum to 
my flow, displaying elegant and dignified 
movements.

It makes me want to surrender entirely to 
the gentle current— a dance reminiscent of 
a clear, pristine stream.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Do the gazes around us distract you? Right 
now, you are my partner. You must not look 
elsewhere.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Don't bring your lukewarm half-measures 
into dancing too.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps you should listen more closely to 
the music. Fury is not the only form of 
expression.

Keeping their eyes locked on me, the two 
clash head-to-head. Though their words are 
sharp, the atmosphere in the room is—

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, so incredible! I want to dance 
like that too!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl C
text_block_list.text: Next! Please dance with me next~!

Completely enveloped in a blaze of 
thrilling excitement.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girls
text_block_list.text: That was wonderful~~!!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
I was totally mesmerized... I want to 
dance like that. If I practice more, do 
you think I could do it too?!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! I want to try it too! The way 
they led so fluidly was so super cool!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...I see. That is good to hear.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: (The heat born of clashing... is it?)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
(Indeed. Even when we collide, we do not 
come to a standstill. We are constantly 
striving to move forward.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
(And by generating a passion that draws 
others in, we may guide them to take that 
next step from atop the hundred-foot pole— 
advancing beyond the very limits of what 
seemed possible.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
(Even if our paths never intertwine, and 
even if the destinations we seek differ, 
this blazing passion—surely...)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
(...will lead many others toward their 
untapped potential.)

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Both of us were amazing? ...You still 
don't get it, do you? Come here. I'll show 
you one more time.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, indeed. Allow us to make sure you 
feel it thoroughly. This heat that guides 
so many.

In front of me, sparks practically flew 
between the two, while behind me stood a 
crowd of envious Horse Girls.

The phrase 'surrounded on all sides' 
unbiddenly crossed my mind...
